desc: Implement a function `min_cost_for_K(K, P)` that computes the minimum cost to buy exactly K units by binary searching on a threshold parameter to determine optimal $k_i$ values.
Implement binary search on the answer $K$ from 0 to $N \times \text{large}$, but since $M \leq 10^{18}$ and min $P_i \geq 1$, max $K \leq 10^9$ (roughly), so binary search range is [0, 2*10^9].
For each candidate $K$ in the binary search, use `min_cost_for_K` to check if cost $\leq M$.
Handle edge cases: $N=1$, very large $P_i$, etc.
Read input, sort $P_i$ for efficiency in the allocation function.
